mail/imap_response#

IMAP server responses: tagged, untagged or continuation, with their literals framed (RFC 9051 §7).

Version: v1.0.0

Synopsis#

let response = ParsedImapResponse(bytes).response();
response.kind();                      // ImapResponseKind.untagged
response.name();                      // "FETCH", "EXISTS", "OK"…
for response.parts() -> part { part.bytes(); }

let decoder = ImapResponseDecoder().fed(chunk);
if decoder.complete() { decoder.response(); }

Description#

IMAP server responses: tagged, untagged or continuation, with their literals framed (RFC 9051 §7).

This frames responses; it does not interpret them (imap_data does). Literals {n} and ~{n} are recognized in the responses std knows; an unknown response name is refused, since its grammar may differ. By default a line has 8 KiB, a literal 16 MiB, a response 32 MiB and 100 literals.
